about: The You Can Do It Foundation (ycdif.com, Mesa, Arizona) funds and spotlights value-driven media and the nonprofits behind it: faith, family and freedom. Rob Schneider is the spokesperson. PRIME: You Can Do It Foundation, YCDIF, ycdif.com, Rob Schneider, Clint Carter, Kris

## Names and spellings
- **You Can Do It Foundation**: full name, spelled out, no ampersand.
- **YCDIF**: the acronym, all caps.
- **ycdif.com**: the URL on lower thirds and end cards, all lowercase, .com (not the unrelated youcandoitfoundation.org).
- **Rob Schneider**: one n in Schneider. Spokesperson. Never call him founder, creator or grant recipient (legal).
- **Clint Carter**: Executive Director, the decision maker.
- **Ryan Duran**: Director of Marketing.
- **Kris**: always Kris with a K, never Chris. Use full names in captions.
- **Kris Van House** (Executive Director) and **Greg Van House** (President): Heartland Ranch co-founders.
- **Dylan Harris**: SOMO Collective, YCDIF grant recipient for Learning to Listen.
- **You Can Do It, America!**: the joint launch with the American Rights Alliance (ycdia.org).
- **FreedomFest**: the Las Vegas conference (July 2026) where YCDIF had a booth.
- **The Ends**: the Scottsdale restaurant of the 20 Dec 2025 event.

## Who they are
The You Can Do It Foundation (Mesa, Arizona) inspires, funds and promotes value-driven media that uplifts the human spirit: faith, family and freedom. It funds filmmakers and spotlights nonprofits (Heartland Ranch, Dr. Phil's foundation, the American Rights Alliance and others). Rob Schneider is the spokesperson. Audience: conservative, 35 to 75, values faith, family, freedom and perseverance. Goals: awareness and donations.

## Contacts
- Clint Carter, Executive Director (decision maker).
- Ryan Duran, Director of Marketing (day to day).
- Hannah Fellows (social strategist) and MyBizNiche (social posting and ad specs).

## Editing rules
- Rob is the spokesperson only. Never founder, creator or grant recipient.
- From Rob's Dec 2025 speech, only the culture/entertainment and gratitude lines are brand-safe. Nothing political.
- Kris with a K. Full names in captions.
- Slower fade-outs.
- Remove the logo from social versions. Logo on end cards only.
- Deliver horizontal and vertical versions for social pieces.
- Rob prefers no bright backlight.
- Speakers sit up straight: slouching was the one con on the first videos (Clint, 3 Dec 2025).
- Dr. Phil content: shared with Dr. Phil's social team before it is posted on YCDIF socials. YCDIF handles that.
- Social approvals go through Hannah Fellows, then MyBizNiche.
- American Rights Alliance content: nothing about a matter still before a court, on appeal or under a settlement term; a named exonerated person needs their own written permission.
- Hopeful, never somber.

## Brand
From the ycdif.com site CSS (no brand guide on file). Logo is a black/charcoal wordmark.
- Gold #DAA520 (primary), slate teal #294145, dark gold #A57D18, deep teal #121D1F, black #000000, body gray #585858, white #FFFFFF.
- Headings Plus Jakarta Sans, body Fustat (both Google Fonts).
- Captions: black text on a gold #DAA520 box. Never white on gold (too little contrast).
